GetPegadbSlowLogTemplate.start: Query start time in UTC format, e.g., 2025-09-01T00:00:00Z
GetPegadbSlowLogTemplate.end: Query end time in UTC format, e.g., 2025-09-02T00:00:00Z
GetPegadbSlowLogTemplate.page: Page number for pagination, default is 1
GetPegadbSlowLogTemplate.pageSize: Number of records per page, default is 20
GetPegadbSlowLogTemplate.orderBy: Sort field, defaults to execution count. Supported fields: executeTime (execution count), logDurationSum (total execution time), logDurationMax (maximum execution time), logDurationAvg (average execution time)
GetPegadbSlowLogTemplate.order: Sort direction, valid values are asc and desc, default is desc
